prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a square reaction image of a butter-yellow cartoon cat caught at the peak of a belly laugh. Give it the silhouette of a plump pear, with a broad, frog-like head that runs straight into its round belly. Two little triangular ears, a pink cat nose, and whiskers on the bulging cheeks make it unmistakably feline. Frame it close in a slight three-quarter view. Its head tips back, its eyes squeeze into upside-down U’s, and its mouth stretches almost from ear to ear. The lower jaw drops into a soft double chin, revealing a dark mouth, a curled pink tongue, and two tiny cat fangs. Its little front paws hover over its belly as if it can barely catch its breath. Render it like a still from a goofy 3D cartoon, with smooth, squishy forms, warm light, and a plain background. No lettering or captions.
